message: Hi, my little one Finn is 6 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! We have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes that are perfect for 6-year-olds. They're grouped by age with instruction designed just for them. Would you like to book a free trial class for Finn?
Yes, please! What time slots do you have available?
Great! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Nice to meet you, Tester! Can I grab your email address? It helps us send you the trial details and class info.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Finn's full name and date of birth to get him set up for the trial.
Finn Willow, and his birthday is May 25, 2020.

Perfect! Here are some available times for Finn's free trial:

Tuesday 7/7 at 5:15 PM
Wednesday 7/8 at 4:30 PM
Thursday 7/9 at 5:15 PM
Saturday 7/11 at 9:15 AM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Tuesday 7/7 at 5:15 PM.

Perfect! Finn is all set for his free trial on Tuesday, July 7th at 5:15 PM. We'll send you a confirmation email with all the details. Just bring Finn in comfortable clothes and we'll take care of the rest. See you then!
